description: One test's result, set by itself (no bundling): {script, suite, test, verified, severity}, severity from 0.0 to 1.0. A script with no row, or changed since its row, gets its script and suite rows first, as a change makes them. The same result as the test's current row moves its tested and its judged, the script's hash, and its severity only upward; a flipped result makes a new current row and keeps the old one as history, its severity the higher of the two. Answers the test's current row. A name that is no production script answers "not a production script"; a script neither there nor known, "no such file".
